title: Mysterious Cosmic Altar
description: A person's hand with a ring rests on a dark floating table covered in circles and painted marks. Above the table a glowing heart shape made of lines floats in the air with light and smoke rising from the center while white moths fly nearby.
prompt: a person's hand with a ring rests on a dark floating rectangular table covered in painted circles and marks. above the table a large glowing geometric heart shape made of lines floats in the air with light smoke and energy rising from its center. white moths fly around the table. the background shows a dark arched hall with swirling patterns on the walls and colorful aurora lights across the top of the scene.
